scope: every Python module in python.unreachable plus every Rust file in rust.crate_detail[*].unreachable_files

label_definitions.SCRIPT: one-shot tool living in a package dir for convenience; run by hand, imported by nothing
label_definitions.DEAD: superseded or never-wired; no caller, no test, no entrypoint. Deletion deferred: G7 forbids deleting files.
label_definitions.MISSING-DECL: real module never declared (no import edge in Python, no `mod`/[[bin]] declaration in Rust)
label_definitions.TEST-ONLY: reachable only from tests / a test asset
